messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — i'm starting onboarding for kelpie-4b-open (Apache-2.0 upstream) for the catalog. need owners for: perf profile, legal check, routing policy, and embedding shape. plan to open model-card PR later today. pinging @Samir for perf numbers, @Maria for canary infra, @Jamie for docs SDK snippet.

Samir: got it. i'll run the perf suite on p4d and a rent-a-gpu. rough numbers incoming, but expect ~8–10 tok/s per GPU at seq=2048 with q4_0. will post logs.

Maria: infra can allocate a canary window next Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic). i need the runtime kernel patch merged or i'll have to push the window.

Kevin: product q: what's the latency target? p50 50ms or something laxer for these open models? also any Dedicated customer constraints we should be aware of?

Anya: aiming for p50=120ms for typical 1k-token conv. Dedicated customers can get tighter profiles; we'll add routing policy to prefer quantized variant for cost-sensitive traffic.

LegalBot: License scan result: repo is Apache-2.0 but contains a submodule with MIT. please attach upstream license file and confirm attribution in the model card. marking as required for catalog inclusion.

Samir: perf run finished — snippet below:
```
model=kelpie-4b-open
batch=1
seq=2048
p50=118ms
p95=230ms
gpu_mem=16GB
quant=q4_0
```

Samir: notes: q4_0 keeps accuracy within ~0.7% on our eval set vs fp16. for Dedicated we can try q8_0 (saves ~35% cost) but need a small eval sweep.

Jamie: docs/SDK: i'll take the model-card PR. include an example SDK call and embedding shape. also add a short migration note: embedding_dim=1536 (embedding vector length).

Anya: opening PR now: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/482>. pls review owners and checklist.

Maria: one infra blocker: eng-runtime needs kernel patch for the fused attention op (PR #712) merged before canary. cc @eng-runtime.

Kevin: ops question — who signs off the rollout? Product + SRE or do we need Legal explicit signoff too for catalog entries?

Anya: prefer joint signoff: Perf (Samir), Infra (Maria), Legal (LegalBot), Docs (Jamie). i'll include a roll-forward/rollback plan in the PR.

Samir: tiny ask — can someone approve the quant-test CR? it's trivial but blocks the q8_0 perf sweep.

Jamie: i'll review doc changes today and add the SDK example. can someone paste the embedding response shape so i don't guess?

Samir: embedding_dim is 1536. example response: {"embedding": [1536 floats]}.

LegalBot: flagged: missing upstream attribution section in the PR. pls add a short paragraph and attach the upstream LICENSE file. re-running scan after update.

eng-runtime-bot: buildkite pipeline started for kernel-patch #712 — tests queued.

Maria: noted. i'll hold the canary window until the kernel patch passes. if green by EOD Friday we keep Wed canary.

Anya: thanks. if no blockers by EOD Fri, i'll schedule canary for Wed. owners: perf=Samir, infra=Maria, legal=LegalBot, docs=Jamie.

Kevin: ack :thumbsup:

Samir: timeline works for me.

Jamie: noted, will review ASAP.

LegalBot: will re-scan after PR update and follow up with exact attribution language.
